g.text: Print EP banner and project information
Configure NANDC and initialize device interface
because NANDC accesses them through DMA.
Print "Run Write 5 pages before Read and Verify"
Print "Run Write 5 pages or Raw Write 5 pages before Raw Read"
Prepare Pattern A and Pattern B
Wait ready and clear remap table
Erase Page A and Page B blocks
Write Pattern A to Page A
Write Pattern B through logical Page A
Read logical A and verify Pattern B
Clear remap, read A and B, verify both patterns
Wait ready and clear remap table
Erase target block and wait ready
Write same page, read back, and verify data
Each measured operation resets callback state,
starts GPT, issues the NANDC API, waits for the
expected callback, then converts timer counts to ns.
